dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the Python scripts, simulation data, and plotting notebooks used in the thermo-mechanical modeling of HDPE–Birch fiber reinforced spur gears. The study evaluates gear performance under varying torques and rotational speeds using structural and thermal simulations.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Thermo-Mechanical Modeling of HDPE – Birch Fiber Reinforced Spur Gears
